# Dependencies of the Tooling repository itself. The synced scripts
# and the tests run on core Perl; the lint and format gates need these.
test cpan Perl::Critic
test cpan Perl::Tidy
# The secret gate of make check runs gitleaks. The tool environment
# installs before every other one, so the gate has its binary in each
# deps chain. The release assets name the x86_64 architecture "x64",
# and the alias table of the fugubench deps verb resolves it.
tool bin gitleaks https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_{os}_{arch}.tar.gz gitleaks
